Welcome to Pixelated episode 123. This week, Damien and Abner share their earliest impressions of the Fitbit Edge, Google's latest fitness tracker that promises to split the difference between the Fitbit Air and the Pixel Watch 5. author: 9to5Google
description:
From the ambitious shift to custom Tensor silicon and a bold new design language to the frustrating software bugs and connectivity issues that plagued early adopters, we explore how this device served as a necessary, albeit painful, learning experience. Join us as we analyze the camera performance, the impact of the Tensor chip, and the long-term legacy of the Pixel 6 as the foundation for Google's modern smartphone ecosystem.
